stories.title: OpenAI proposes shared AI progress limits tied to perplexity
stories.alt: Conceptual panel linking held-out prediction loss to proposed shared safety limits, while distinguishing the metric from downstream task performance.
stories.facts: OpenAI’s chief scientist proposes using perplexity alongside other measurements to compare AI progress and establish shared development limits tied to monitoring capabilities.
stories.inference: Keep model-score improvements separate from task-specific validation and permission controls in research assistants.
stories.uncertainty: A proposal, not an adopted industry rule. Cross-lab datasets differ, and perplexity does not measure every downstream capability.

stories.title: Covariance study finds no added benefit from physics-inspired features
nodes:
Reported null result
No significant gain
stories.alt: Conceptual study panel showing neural covariance inputs evaluated through walk-forward tests, with no significant net Sharpe improvement reported.
stories.facts: Gabriele Ranco’s preprint reports no significant improvement over HAR-RV or LSTM benchmarks from its physics-inspired covariance framework, and no significant portfolio Sharpe improvement after costs.
stories.inference: Require feature ablations and equally tuned simple benchmarks before adding complexity to a MATLAB risk model.
stories.uncertainty: Author-reported preprint results on 29 DJIA stocks using 2012–2015 data; not proof that the features never help or that the analysis is independently replicated.

stories.title: U.S. futures rebound sharply before Monday’s cash open
stories.alt: Zero-based bar chart of reported November 23 futures gains at 4:17 a.m. CST: Dow E-mini 1.94%, S&P 500 E-mini 2.72%, Nasdaq-100 E-mini 3.52%; not ETF returns or live quotes.
stories.facts: Reuters reported Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 E-mini futures up 1.94%, 2.72% and 3.52%, respectively, at 5:17 a.m. Eastern after last week’s selloff.
stories.inference: Treat the rebound as opening-gap risk; wait for fresh spread and depth evidence before increasing participation.
stories.uncertainty: A reported premarket snapshot, not live executable prices, SPY/QQQ returns or evidence of a durable recovery.

stories.title: Today’s flash U.S. PMI lands fifteen minutes after the cash open
stories.credit: S&P Global PMI release calendar, Nov. 2026
stories.alt: Calendar panel showing the cash open at 8:30 a.m. CST and scheduled U.S. flash PMI at 8:45 a.m. CST on November 23; results are unknown.
stories.facts: S&P Global’s release calendar schedules November’s flash U.S. PMI for November 23 at 9:45 a.m. Eastern, equivalent to 8:45 a.m. Central.
stories.inference: Separate the opening-auction window from the PMI event window when evaluating intraday signals and fill assumptions.
stories.uncertainty: Scheduled survey release, not published results or a forecast of Fed action. Recheck the calendar before execution.

stories.title: CrowdStrike and Zscaler announce a definitive acquisition agreement
stories.date: Announced November 23, 2026; material update to November 20 talks
stories.alt: Conceptual transaction panel showing CrowdStrike and Zscaler’s definitive all-stock acquisition agreement with an approximately 43.9 billion stated valuation, explicitly distinguished from a completed merger.
stories.facts: CrowdStrike and Zscaler announced a definitive all-stock acquisition agreement valuing Zscaler at approximately $43.9 billion. This advances the previously reported talks to an announced transaction.
stories.inference: For event studies, distinguish announcement risk from completion risk and model stock-consideration exposure rather than a fixed cash payoff.
stories.uncertainty: The deal is proposed, not completed. Regulatory and shareholder approvals and integration outcomes remain uncertain.
